name: mofumouse-electron-prototype
author: UDteach
description: Photoreal animal cursor prototype for Windows and macOS

scripts.check: node --check app/main.cjs && node --check app/preload.cjs && node --check app/renderer.mjs && npm test && npm run prepare:assets
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:assets && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run prepare:assets && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run prepare:assets && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run dist:mac:arm64 && npm run dist:mac:x64
